messages:
lia_custsuccess: Hey team — Mosaic Health reached out asking to onboard a customer-provided domain-tuned 7B multilingual summarizer. They flagged PHI handling, HSM keywrap for model weights, and a private VPC deploy. timeline: wants POC in 3 weeks. :alarm_clock:

sam_prodsec: Thanks Lia — quick q: is the model going to see live PHI during inference or only on-prem batch evaluation? we need to decide if we require Private (VPC/on-prem) from day 1. :thinking_face:

lia_custsuccess: They said inference will be behind their app and PHI will flow in production. So yes, production path will carry PHI. POC can use redacted test set but infra must match production (VPC + HSM).

jordan_legal: Looping in — we need the DPA/BAA check and confirmation of data residency. also need model provenance + export controls. ask Mosaic for a model checksum and license (safetensors / proprietary).

devon_mleng: From ML side: important to know model format (safetensors/pt/gguf), float/quantized, and whether kv-cache supports continuous batching. Also send us a small eval set (50-100 prompts) with PHI-like examples to run safety/regression tests.

lia_custsuccess: I asked for model artifact details and a short eval pack. Mosaic said model is safetensors, 7B, float16 trained with domain-adapted tokenizer. They can provide a redacted eval set and a small dev key for testing.

sam_prodsec: Ok — requirement checklist for Private onboarding: 1) BAA signed, 2) HSM integration plan + key lifecycle, 3) network allowlist and VPC peering, 4) model checksum & license, 5) safety eval results (we can run). I'll paste our minimums below.

sam_prodsec: ```
# minimum private onboarding items
- Signed BAA/contract addendum
- Model artifact: safetensors + sha256
- Deployment: VPC peering, NAT rules, egress blocklist
- KMS/HSM: keywrap + rotation cadence
- Eval: PHI-sensitivity suite + hallucination checks
```

devon_mleng: For safety/regression harness I'll run: ppl + hallucination rate + entity leakage (PHI tokens). Suggested command for their artifact (internal):

```bash
python infra/eval_harness.py \
  --model /mnt/models/mosaic-7b.safetensors \
  --prompts evals/mosaic_phi.jsonl \
  --checks ppl,entity_leak,agg_factuality \
  --output results/mosaic_poc_report.json
```

lia_custsuccess: Mosaic also asked about quantization guidance — they prefer int8 to save memory. are we comfortable recommending a quantized deployment for PHI workloads?

devon_mleng: We can support quantized profiles but for PHI workloads we recommend validating F1/recall on their eval set post-quantization. If the customer requires strict fidelity, suggest float16 on Dedicated GPUs as default for POC. :thumbsup:

jordan_legal: Also confirm whether Mosaic will host model weights or require Redwood to store them in customer-managed storage. If they want Redwood to hold keys, legal wants explicit KMS SLA language.

lia_custsuccess: Customer prefers Redwood-managed model storage but with HSM-wrapped keys and restricted access. they agreed to sign the addendum if HSM flow is documented.

deploybot: Deploy check queued — cluster capacity probe returned: dedicated-pool-us-east has 2 spare T4-equivalents next week, better to reserve earlier for the POC slot. (Probe id: cb-2388-POC) :gear:
